source.ref: raw/datasheets/loggers/Solis_S3-Logger_DS.pdf p.2; references/catalog-sources/extracted/logger_datasheets.csv row 2; India edition (solisinverters.com/in). Manages Solis inverters, meters and weather stations; the sheet says inverters must first be daisy-chained hand-in-hand on RS485. Power consumption 5 W; rail or desktop mounting; operating -40 to +80 C. The S3-Logger-EPM variant of the same sheet adds zero power output and is not catalogued.
